title: Amazon's cloud business grows 39%, but $42 billion in cash flows out: Is AI spending becoming too expensive?
summary: Amazon Web Services revenue rose 39.3% to $46 billion in the third quarter, its fastest growth in nearly five years. But AI-driven capital spending is weighing on cash flow: free cash flow turned negative at $42.4 billion.
